name: ms-sushant-construction
description: M/S SUSHANT CONSTRUCTION - construction material supplier website + admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --workspace server && npm run db:seed --workspace server
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/package.test.mjs && npm run test:unit --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
